top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise as Houthi Strikes Revive Supply Disruption Fears
top_signals.summary: Oil prices rose on Friday but were set for a weekly decline as concerns over supply disruptions grew following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh and reports of tanker disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.Brent crude futures LCOc1 rose 59 cents, or 0.6%, to $92.57 a barrel by 0720 GMT.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
